source_control.note: This pack closes published learner-study gaps in command signs and warning markings. It uses original explanatory wording and original schematic visuals; it does not copy manual page artwork.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.2 — Minimum speed sign R101/TR101

en.title: Minimum speed sign
en.key_point: Do not drive slower than the speed shown on the sign.
en.explanation: This command sign is used where very slow traffic could disrupt traffic flow. The displayed number is the minimum speed in km/h.

af.title: Minimumspoedteken
af.key_point: Moenie stadiger ry as die spoed wat op die teken aangedui word nie.
af.explanation: Die teken word gebruik waar baie stadige verkeer die verkeersvloei kan belemmer.

xh.title: Uphawu lwesantya esisezantsi
xh.key_point: Musa ukuqhuba ngaphantsi kwesantya esiboniswe kuphawu.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lusetyenziswa apho ukuhamba kancinci kakhulu kunokuphazamisa ukuhamba kwezithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.2 — Keep right R104

en.title: Keep right
en.key_point: Pass to the right of the obstruction when the Keep Right sign applies.
en.explanation: The sign is used at an obstruction such as a traffic island and tells you which side of the obstruction to use.

af.title: Hou regs
af.key_point: Gaan regs van die versperring verby wanneer die Hou Regs-teken geld.
af.explanation: Die teken wys aan watter kant van 'n versperring jy moet verbygaan.

xh.title: Hlala ngasekunene
xh.key_point: Dlula ngasekunene komqobo xa olu phawu lusebenza.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lubonisa icala omele ulisebenzise xa udlula umqobo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.2 — Proceed right only R106

en.title: Proceed right only
en.key_point: Drive only in the direction shown by the right-pointing arrow.
en.explanation: This command sign is used at intersections to control the direction in which traffic may proceed.

af.title: Gaan slegs regs
af.key_point: Ry slegs in die rigting wat deur die regsgerigte pyl aangedui word.
af.explanation: Hierdie bevelteken beheer die toegelate rigting by 'n aansluiting.

xh.title: Qhubeka ngasekunene kuphela
xh.key_point: Qhuba kuphela kwicala eliboniswe lutolo olujonge ngasekunene.
xh.explanation: Olu phawu lulawula indlela evumelekileyo kwindawo yokudibana.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.2 — Pedestrians only R110

en.title: Pedestrians only
en.key_point: The indicated road or part of the road is reserved for pedestrians.
en.explanation: Drivers and riders must not use the part of the road reserved by this command sign.

af.title: Slegs voetgangers
af.key_point: Die aangeduide pad of deel van die pad is vir voetgangers gereserveer.
af.explanation: Bestuurders en ryers mag nie die gereserveerde deel gebruik nie.

xh.title: Abahambi ngeenyawo kuphela
xh.key_point: Indlela okanye inxalenye yayo ibekelwe abahambi ngeenyawo.
xh.explanation: Abaqhubi nabakhweli bezithuthuthu akufanele bayisebenzise loo ndawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.2 — Cyclists only R111

en.title: Cyclists only
en.key_point: The indicated road or part of the road is reserved for cyclists.
en.explanation: Drivers and riders who are not using a pedal cycle must not use the part of the road reserved by this sign.

af.title: Slegs fietsryers
af.key_point: Die aangeduide pad of deel van die pad is vir fietsryers gereserveer.
af.explanation: Ander voertuie mag nie die gereserveerde deel gebruik nie.

xh.title: Abakhweli beebhayisekile kuphela
xh.key_point: Indlela okanye inxalenye yayo ibekelwe abakhweli beebhayisekile.
xh.explanation: Ezinye izithuthi akufanele zisebenzise loo ndawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Railway crossing ahead WM1

en.title: Railway crossing ahead marking
en.key_point: Slow down and be ready to stop before the railway crossing.
en.explanation: This warning marking is placed before a railway crossing to give additional warning that the crossing is ahead.

af.title: Spooroorgang voor-padmerk
af.key_point: Ry stadiger en wees gereed om voor die spooroorgang te stop.
af.explanation: Die merk gee bykomende waarskuwing dat 'n spooroorgang voorlê.

xh.title: Uphawu lwendlela lokuwela koololiwe ngaphambili
xh.key_point: Cotha uze ulungele ukuma phambi kwendawo yokuwela koololiwe.
xh.explanation: Olu phawu lwendlela lunika isilumkiso esongezelelweyo sokuba kukho indawo yokuwela koololiwe ngaphambili.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Continuity lines WM2

en.title: Continuity lines
en.key_point: A lane beside a continuity line may soon turn away or meet a break in the roadway.
en.explanation: Check mirrors and blind spots and allow for other traffic changing lanes. The marking warns that an intersection or off-ramp affects the continuing lane arrangement.

af.title: Kontinuïteitslyne
af.key_point: 'n Baan langs 'n kontinuïteitslyn kan binnekort wegdraai of 'n onderbreking in die rybaan bereik.
af.explanation: Let op vir voertuie wat van baan verander en kies jou baan vroeg.

xh.title: Imigca yokuqhubeka
xh.key_point: Ilayini esecaleni komgca wokuqhubeka inokuthi kungekudala ijike okanye ifike kwindawo etshintsha ngayo indlela.
xh.explanation: Qaphela izithuthi ezitshintsha iilayini uze ukhethe ilayini kwangethuba.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Dividing lines WM3

en.title: Dividing lines
en.key_point: Traffic on the other side of the dividing line is travelling in the opposite direction.
en.explanation: Stay alert for approaching vehicles and keep safely to your side of the road.

af.title: Skeidingslyne
af.key_point: Verkeer aan die ander kant van die skeidingslyn beweeg in die teenoorgestelde rigting.
af.explanation: Bly aan jou kant van die pad en let op aankomende verkeer.

xh.title: Imigca yokwahlula
xh.key_point: Izithuthi kwelinye icala lomgca wokwahlula zihamba kwelinye icala.
xh.explanation: Hlala kwicala lakho lendlela uze uqaphele izithuthi eziza kuwe.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Reversible lane lines WM4

en.title: Reversible lane lines
en.key_point: The direction of traffic in the marked lane can change at different times.
en.explanation: Look for the lane-control signals that apply and be alert for traffic travelling in the opposite direction.

af.title: Omkeerbare baanlyne
af.key_point: Die verkeersrigting in die gemerkte baan kan op verskillende tye verander.
af.explanation: Volg die toepaslike baanbeheerseine.

xh.title: Imigca yelayini etshintsha icala
xh.key_point: Indlela yokuhamba kwezithuthi kule layini inokutshintsha ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo.
xh.explanation: Landela iimpawu zolawulo lwelayini ezisebenzayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Height limit R204/TR204

en.title: Height limit
en.key_point: Do not enter if your vehicle or load is higher than the height shown.
en.explanation: The sign warns of a height restriction ahead. Use another route if your vehicle or load exceeds the indicated height.

af.title: Hoogtebeperking
af.key_point: Moenie ingaan as jou voertuig of vrag hoër is as die hoogte op die teken nie.
af.explanation: Gebruik 'n ander roete indien jou voertuig of vrag die aangeduide hoogte oorskry.

xh.title: Umda wokuphakama
xh.key_point: Musa ukungena ukuba isithuthi okanye umthwalo wakho uphezulu kunomlinganiselo obonisiwe.
xh.explanation: Sebenzisa enye indlela ukuba isithuthi okanye umthwalo wakho ugqitha kumda obonisiweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Length limit R205/TR205

en.title: Length limit
en.key_point: Do not use the road if your vehicle or combination is longer than the length shown.
en.explanation: The restriction protects roads where long vehicles may not be able to negotiate curves safely.

af.title: Lengtebeperking
af.key_point: Moenie die pad gebruik as jou voertuig of kombinasie langer is as die lengte wat aangedui word nie.
af.explanation: Die beperking beskerm paaie waar lang voertuie nie veilig kan beweeg nie.

xh.title: Umda wobude
xh.key_point: Musa ukusebenzisa indlela ukuba isithuthi okanye indibaniselwano yakho inde kunobude obubonisiwe.
xh.explanation: Umda ukhusela iindlela apho izithuthi ezinde zingenakuhamba ngokukhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Excessive noise prohibited R206

en.title: Excessive noise prohibited
en.key_point: Do not proceed with a vehicle producing excessive noise, and avoid unnecessary hooter use where this sign applies.
en.explanation: The sign is used in noise-sensitive areas. The manual also links it to a restriction on hooter use after the sign.

af.title: Oormatige geraas verbode
af.key_point: Moenie voortgaan met 'n voertuig wat oormatige geraas maak nie en vermy onnodige toetergebruik waar die teken geld.
af.explanation: Die teken word in geraassensitiewe gebiede gebruik.

xh.title: Ingxolo egqithisileyo ayivumelekanga
xh.key_point: Musa ukuqhubeka ngesithuthi esenza ingxolo egqithisileyo kwaye uphephe ukusebenzisa ihutha ngaphandle kwesidingo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lusetyenziswa kwiindawo ezibuthathaka kwingxolo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Hitch-hiking prohibited R207

en.title: Hitch-hiking prohibited
en.key_point: Do not stop to pick up hitch-hikers where the prohibition applies.
en.explanation: The official learner manual says the sign prohibits hitch-hiking and restricts drivers from picking up passengers for the distance stated in the manual.

af.title: Duimgooi verbode
af.key_point: Moenie stop om duimgooiers op te laai waar die verbod geld nie.
af.explanation: Die teken verbied duimgooi in die aangeduide gebied.

xh.title: Ukucela ilifti akuvumelekanga
xh.key_point: Musa ukuma ukuthatha abantu abacela ilifti apho olu thintelo lusebenza.
xh.explanation: Uphawu luyakwalela ukucela ilifti kuloo ndawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Unauthorised vehicles prohibited R208/TR208

en.title: Unauthorised vehicles prohibited
en.key_point: Do not enter unless you have special authorisation.
en.explanation: This sign closes a road or road section to ordinary traffic. Temporary versions are commonly used at roadworks.

af.title: Ongemagtigde voertuie verbode
af.key_point: Moenie ingaan tensy jy spesiale magtiging het nie.
af.explanation: Hierdie teken sluit 'n pad of padgedeelte vir gewone verkeer.

xh.title: Izithuthi ezingagunyaziswanga azivumelekanga
xh.key_point: Musa ukungena ngaphandle kokuba unemvume ekhethekileyo.
xh.explanation: Olu phawu luvala indlela okanye inxalenye yendlela kwizithuthi eziqhelekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Left turn ahead prohibited R209/TR209

en.title: Left turn ahead prohibited
en.key_point: Do not turn left at the upcoming intersection.
en.explanation: This prohibition is placed before the junction so you can choose another route before reaching it.

af.title: Linksdraai vorentoe verbode
af.key_point: Moenie by die komende kruising links draai nie.
af.explanation: Die teken waarsku jou vooraf sodat jy 'n ander roete kan kies.

xh.title: Ukujika ngasekhohlo ngaphambili akuvumelekanga
xh.key_point: Musa ukujika ngasekhohlo kwindawo yokudibana ezayo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lukuxelela kwangaphambili ukuze ukhethe enye indlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Right turn ahead prohibited R210/TR210

en.title: Right turn ahead prohibited
en.key_point: Do not turn right at the upcoming intersection.
en.explanation: This prohibition is placed before the junction so you can choose another route before reaching it.

af.title: Regsdraai vorentoe verbode
af.key_point: Moenie by die komende kruising regs draai nie.
af.explanation: Die teken waarsku jou vooraf sodat jy 'n ander roete kan kies.

xh.title: Ukujika ngasekunene ngaphambili akuvumelekanga
xh.key_point: Musa ukujika ngasekunene kwindawo yokudibana ezayo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lukuxelela kwangaphambili ukuze ukhethe enye indlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.3 — Overtaking prohibited R214/TR214

en.title: Overtaking prohibited
en.key_point: Do not overtake where the sign applies.
en.explanation: The learner manual associates this sign with a defined prohibition distance. Obey any additional distance or secondary-message information displayed.

af.title: Verbysteek verbode
af.key_point: Moenie verbysteek waar die teken geld nie.
af.explanation: Volg enige bykomende afstand- of boodskapplaat wat saam met die teken vertoon word.

xh.title: Ukudlula akuvumelekanga
xh.key_point: Musa ukudlula apho olu phawu lusebenza.
xh.explanation: Landela naluphi na ulwazi olongezelelweyo lomgama okanye umyalezo oboniswa nophawu.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Pre-advance exit direction GA1

en.title: Freeway pre-advance exit direction
en.key_point: An off-ramp exit is coming. If you intend to leave the freeway, prepare to move left in good time.
en.explanation: The manual places this sign well before the exit so drivers have early warning of the routes available ahead.

af.title: Vroeë snelweg-afritrigting
af.key_point: 'n Afrit kom nader. As jy die snelweg wil verlaat, berei betyds voor om links te beweeg.
af.explanation: Die teken gee vroeë waarskuwing oor die afrit en bestemmings.

xh.title: Isalathiso sokuqala sokuphuma kwindlela enkulu
xh.key_point: Ukuphuma kusondele. Ukuba ufuna ukuphuma, lungiselela ukuya ngasekhohlo kwangethuba.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lunika isilumkiso kwangaphambili malunga nokuphuma neendawo eziya kuzo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Advance exit direction GA2

en.title: Freeway advance exit direction
en.key_point: The freeway exit is getting closer. Move toward the left lane in good time if you are leaving.
en.explanation: This sign gives another advance indication of the exit and destinations served by it.

af.title: Vooraf-afritrigting
af.key_point: Die snelwegafrit kom nader. Beweeg betyds na die linkerbaan as jy gaan afdraai.
af.explanation: Die teken gee nog 'n vooraf-aanduiding van die afrit.

xh.title: Isalathiso sokuphuma esisondelayo
xh.key_point: Ukuphuma kwindlela enkulu kuyasondela. Hamba kwilayini yasekhohlo kwangethuba ukuba uza kuphuma.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lunika olunye ulwazi lwangaphambili malunga nokuphuma.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Supplementary exit direction GA2/3, TGA2/3

en.title: Supplementary exit direction
en.key_point: If you are taking the exit, you should already be positioning in the extreme left lane.
en.explanation: This sign confirms the approaching off-ramp shortly before the exit.

af.title: Aanvullende afritrigting
af.key_point: As jy die afrit neem, behoort jy reeds in die heel linkse baan te wees.
af.explanation: Die teken bevestig dat die afrit baie naby is.

xh.title: Isalathiso esongezelelweyo sokuphuma
xh.key_point: Ukuba uza kuphuma, kufuneka sele ukwilayini ekude ngasekhohlo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu luqinisekisa ukuba ukuphuma kusondele kakhulu.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Exit direction GA3

en.title: Freeway exit direction
en.key_point: This marks the actual exit. Leave the freeway only from the correct exit lane.
en.explanation: The sign is positioned at or very near the off-ramp to show exactly where the exit begins.

af.title: Snelweg-afritrigting
af.key_point: Hierdie teken merk die werklike afrit. Verlaat die snelweg net vanuit die korrekte afritbaan.
af.explanation: Die teken staan by of baie naby die begin van die afrit.

xh.title: Isalathiso sokuphuma kwindlela enkulu
xh.key_point: Olu phawu luphawula indawo yokuphuma. Phuma kuphela kwilayini echanekileyo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lubekwa apho ukuphuma kuqala khona okanye kufutshane kakhulu nalapho.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Gore exit GA4/TGA4

en.title: Gore exit direction
en.key_point: Pass on the exit side if you are leaving the freeway and on the through-road side if you are continuing.
en.explanation: The gore sign marks the separation between the off-ramp and the continuing freeway.

af.title: Gore-afritrigting
af.key_point: Gebruik die afritkant as jy die snelweg verlaat en die deurpadkant as jy voortgaan.
af.explanation: Die teken merk die skeiding tussen die afrit en die snelweg wat voortgaan.

xh.title: Isalathiso se-gore sokuphuma
xh.key_point: Sebenzisa icala lokuphuma ukuba uyaphuma, okanye icala lendlela eqhubekayo ukuba uyaqhubeka.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lubonisa ukwahlukana phakathi kwendlela yokuphuma nendlela enkulu eqhubekayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Advance off-ramp terminal direction GA5

en.title: Advance off-ramp terminal direction
en.key_point: Choose the correct lane before reaching the intersection at the end of the off-ramp.
en.explanation: The sign tells you in advance which lane leads to the destination you want after the off-ramp.

af.title: Vooraf-rigting by afrit-eindpunt
af.key_point: Kies die korrekte baan voordat jy die kruising aan die einde van die afrit bereik.
af.explanation: Die teken help jou vooraf om die regte baan vir jou bestemming te kies.

xh.title: Isalathiso sangaphambili ekupheleni kwe-off-ramp
xh.key_point: Khetha ilayini echanekileyo ngaphambi kokufika kwindawo yokudibana ekupheleni kwe-off-ramp.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lukunceda ukhethe ilayini efanelekileyo yendawo oya kuyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §5.2 — Off-ramp terminal direction GA6

en.title: Off-ramp terminal direction
en.key_point: Slow down, obey the intersection controls and turn in the direction of your destination.
en.explanation: This sign is placed at the end of the off-ramp and shows the direction of destinations from the intersecting road.

af.title: Rigting by afrit-eindpunt
af.key_point: Ry stadiger, gehoorsaam die kruisingbeheer en draai in die rigting van jou bestemming.
af.explanation: Die teken wys die rigting van bestemmings vanaf die pad aan die einde van die afrit.

xh.title: Isalathiso ekupheleni kwe-off-ramp
xh.key_point: Cotha, landela ulawulo lwendawo yokudibana uze ujike kwicala lendawo oya kuyo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lubonisa indlela eya kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo ukusuka kwindlela ekupheleni kwe-off-ramp.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §§1–2 — temporary signs / sign interpretation

en.title: Temporary road signs
en.key_point: A yellow-background sign warns that normal conditions have changed and that extra attention is required.
en.explanation: Temporary signs are used for situations such as roadworks, collision scenes and temporary traffic control. A sign number beginning with T identifies a temporary sign.

af.title: Tydelike padtekens
af.key_point: 'n Teken met 'n geel agtergrond waarsku dat normale toestande verander het en dat ekstra aandag nodig is.
af.explanation: Tydelike tekens word gebruik by onder meer padwerke, ongelukke en tydelike verkeersbeheer.

xh.title: Iimpawu zendlela zethutyana
xh.key_point: Uphawu olunemvelaphi etyheli lulumkisa ukuba iimeko eziqhelekileyo zitshintshile kwaye kufuneka uqaphele ngakumbi.
xh.explanation: Iimpawu zethutyana zisetyenziswa kwiindlela ezilungiswayo, kwiingozi nakulawulo lwezithuthi lwethutyana.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.4 — Bus reservation R301/TR301 and bus parking reservation R301-P/TR301-P

en.title: Bus reservation
en.key_point: Do not enter or park in a bus-reserved area unless you are driving a bus.
en.explanation: Reservation signs set aside a road, lane or parking area for a particular class of road user or vehicle.

af.title: Busreservering
af.key_point: Moenie 'n gebied wat vir busse gereserveer is binnegaan of daar parkeer tensy jy 'n bus bestuur nie.
af.explanation: Reserveringstekens hou 'n pad, baan of parkeerplek vir 'n spesifieke voertuigklas.

xh.title: Indawo ebekelwe iibhasi
xh.key_point: Musa ukungena okanye ukupaka kwindawo ebekelwe iibhasi ngaphandle kokuba uqhuba ibhasi.
xh.explanation: Iimpawu zokubekelwa bucala zigcinela indlela, ilayini okanye indawo yokupaka udidi oluthile lwesithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.4 — Bus lane reservation R302/TR302 and begins R303/TR303

en.title: Bus lane reservation
en.key_point: Do not use a bus-only lane if you are not driving a permitted bus.
en.explanation: The reservation sign identifies a lane for buses only; the 'begins' version shows where the reserved lane starts.

af.title: Busbaanreservering
af.key_point: Moenie 'n busbaan gebruik as jy nie 'n toegelate bus bestuur nie.
af.explanation: Die teken identifiseer 'n baan wat vir busse gereserveer is.

xh.title: Ilayini ebekelwe iibhasi
xh.key_point: Musa ukusebenzisa ilayini yeebhasi ukuba awuqhubi ibhasi evumelekileyo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lubonisa ilayini ebekelwe iibhasi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.4 — Pedal cycle lane/parking reservation R304/TR304 and R304-P/TR304-P

en.title: Pedal-cycle reservation
en.key_point: Do not use a cycle-reserved lane or parking area unless you are riding a bicycle.
en.explanation: This reservation protects space intended specifically for pedal cyclists.

af.title: Fietsreservering
af.key_point: Moenie 'n baan of parkeerplek wat vir fietse gereserveer is gebruik tensy jy 'n fiets ry nie.
af.explanation: Die reservering beskerm ruimte wat vir fietsryers bedoel is.

xh.title: Indawo ebekelwe iibhayisekile
xh.key_point: Musa ukusebenzisa ilayini okanye indawo yokupaka ebekelwe iibhayisekile ngaphandle kokuba ukhwele ibhayisekile.
xh.explanation: Le ndawo igcinelwe abakhweli beebhayisekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.4 — Parking reservation R305-P/TR305-P and limited parking R306-P/TR306-P

en.title: Parking reservation
en.key_point: Park only according to the conditions shown, including any fee or maximum-stay limit.
en.explanation: The learner manual distinguishes ordinary reserved parking from limited parking where a maximum stay may apply.

af.title: Parkeerreservering
af.key_point: Parkeer slegs volgens die voorwaardes op die teken, insluitend enige fooi of maksimum tyd.
af.explanation: Lees die parkeerreël en enige bykomende paneel saam.

xh.title: Indawo yokupaka ebekelweyo
xh.key_point: Paka kuphela ngokwemiqathango ebonisiweyo, kuquka intlawulo okanye ixesha eliphezulu.
xh.explanation: Funda umthetho wokupaka kunye nayo nayiphi na ipaneli eyongezelelweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.4 — Motorcycle reservation R307/TR307 and parking reservation R307-P/TR307-P

en.title: Motorcycle reservation
en.key_point: A motorcycle-reserved road area or parking area may be used only by motorcycles.
en.explanation: If you are not riding a motorcycle, do not use the road or parking area reserved by this sign.

af.title: Motorfietsreservering
af.key_point: 'n Pad- of parkeergebied wat vir motorfietse gereserveer is, mag net deur motorfietse gebruik word.
af.explanation: Ander voertuigklasse mag nie die gereserveerde ruimte gebruik nie.

xh.title: Indawo ebekelwe izithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Indawo yendlela okanye yokupaka ebekelwe izithuthuthu ingasetyenziswa kuphela zizithuthuthu.
xh.explanation: Ezinye iintlobo zezithuthi akufanele zisebenzise loo ndawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.6 — Time-limit subgroup (R)502/(R)503

en.title: Selective time periods
en.key_point: A regulatory sign with a time-period secondary sign applies only during the times or days shown.
en.explanation: Read the primary regulatory sign together with the secondary time panel before deciding what is permitted.

af.title: Geselekteerde tydperke
af.key_point: 'n Regulerende teken met 'n tydpaneel geld net gedurende die tye of dae wat aangedui word.
af.explanation: Lees die hoofteken en die tydpaneel saam.

xh.title: Amaxesha athile
xh.key_point: Uphawu lolawulo olunepaneli yexesha lusebenza kuphela ngamaxesha okanye ngeentsuku ezibonisiweyo.
xh.explanation: Funda uphawu oluphambili kunye nepanele yexesha kunye.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.6 — Reduced visibility (R)510

en.title: Reduced-visibility restriction
en.key_point: The primary regulatory sign applies when visibility is reduced.
en.explanation: This secondary sign makes the restriction conditional on poor visibility.

af.title: Beperking by swak sig
af.key_point: Die hoof-regulerende teken geld wanneer sigbaarheid verminder is.
af.explanation: Die bykomende paneel maak die beperking afhanklik van swak sig.

xh.title: Umda xa ukubona kubuthathaka
xh.key_point: Uphawu lolawulo oluphambili lusebenza xa ukubona kuncitshisiwe.
xh.explanation: Ipanele eyongezelelweyo yenza umda usebenze kuphela xa ukubona kubuthathaka.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.6 — Daytime (R)511

en.title: Daytime restriction
en.key_point: The primary regulatory sign applies during daytime.
en.explanation: The secondary sign limits the operation of the main restriction to daytime.

af.title: Dagtydbeperking
af.key_point: Die hoof-regulerende teken geld gedurende die dag.
af.explanation: Die bykomende teken beperk die reël tot dagligtyd.

xh.title: Umda wemini
xh.key_point: Uphawu lolawulo oluphambili lusebenza emini.
xh.explanation: Ipanele eyongezelelweyo yenza umthetho usebenze ngexesha lasemini kuphela.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.6 — Night time (R)512

en.title: Night-time restriction
en.key_point: The primary regulatory sign applies during night time.
en.explanation: The secondary sign limits the operation of the main restriction to night-time conditions.

af.title: Nagtydbeperking
af.key_point: Die hoof-regulerende teken geld gedurende die nag.
af.explanation: Die bykomende teken beperk die reël tot nagtyd.

xh.title: Umda wasebusuku
xh.key_point: Uphawu lolawulo oluphambili lusebenza ebusuku.
xh.explanation: Ipanele eyongezelelweyo yenza umthetho usebenze ngexesha lasebusuku kuphela.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.6 — Pay and display (R)523

en.title: Pay and display
en.key_point: Pay the required parking fee and display the proof of payment as directed.
en.explanation: This secondary sign is used with a parking regulation to show that payment is required.

af.title: Betaal en vertoon
af.key_point: Betaal die vereiste parkeerfooi en vertoon die bewys van betaling soos aangedui.
af.explanation: Hierdie paneel wys dat betaling vir parkering vereis word.

xh.title: Hlawula uze ubonise
xh.key_point: Hlawula imali yokupaka efunekayo uze ubonise ubungqina bentlawulo njengoko kuyalelwe.
xh.explanation: Le paneli ibonisa ukuba kufuneka kuhlawulwe ukupaka.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.5 — Dual-carriageway freeway begins R401

en.title: Dual-carriageway freeway begins
en.key_point: From this sign onward, the rules that apply to freeways are in force.
en.explanation: The sign marks the start of a dual-carriageway freeway. Follow all freeway rules from this point.

af.title: Dubbelrybaan-snelweg begin
af.key_point: Vanaf hierdie teken geld die reëls wat op snelweë van toepassing is.
af.explanation: Die teken merk die begin van 'n dubbelrybaan-snelweg.

xh.title: Kuqala indlela enkulu enezindlela ezimbini ezahluliweyo
xh.key_point: Ukusukela kolu phawu, imithetho yendlela enkulu iyasebenza.
xh.explanation: Uphawu luphawula ukuqala kwendlela enkulu enezindlela ezimbini ezahluliweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.5 — Single-carriageway freeway begins R402

en.title: Single-carriageway freeway begins
en.key_point: From this sign onward, freeway rules apply.
en.explanation: This sign marks the start of a single-carriageway freeway.

af.title: Enkelrybaan-snelweg begin
af.key_point: Vanaf hierdie teken geld snelwegreëls.
af.explanation: Die teken merk die begin van 'n enkelrybaan-snelweg.

xh.title: Kuqala indlela enkulu enendlela enye
xh.key_point: Ukusukela kolu phawu, imithetho yendlela enkulu iyasebenza.
xh.explanation: Uphawu luphawula ukuqala kwendlela enkulu enendlela enye.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.5 — Woonerf R403

en.title: Woonerf
en.key_point: Drive slowly and give special priority and attention to pedestrians in the shared residential area.
en.explanation: The learner manual describes special access, pedestrian-priority and low-speed conditions inside a woonerf. Numeric and vehicle-mass details remain subject to the legal verification gate before release certification.

af.title: Woonerf
af.key_point: Ry stadig en gee besondere voorkeur en aandag aan voetgangers in die gedeelde woongebied.
af.explanation: Dit is 'n gedeelde gebied waar voertuie besonder versigtig moet beweeg.

xh.title: Indawo yokuhlala ekwabelwana ngayo
xh.key_point: Qhuba kancinci uze unike abahambi ngeenyawo ingqalelo ephambili kwindawo yokuhlala ekwabelwana ngayo.
xh.explanation: Le yindawo ekwabelwana ngayo apho izithuthi kufuneka zihambe ngononophelo olukhulu.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.7 — Combination signs (regulatory)

en.title: Combination regulatory signs
en.key_point: Read the main regulatory sign together with every secondary panel or condition attached to it.
en.explanation: A combination may limit a rule by time, vehicle class, distance, visibility or another condition. The full combined message determines what you must do.

af.title: Gekombineerde regulerende tekens
af.key_point: Lees die hoof-regulerende teken saam met elke bykomende paneel of voorwaarde wat daaraan geheg is.
af.explanation: Tyd, voertuigklas, afstand, sigbaarheid of ander voorwaardes kan die betekenis verander.

xh.title: Iimpawu zolawulo ezidityanisiweyo
xh.key_point: Funda uphawu lolawulo oluphambili kunye nayo yonke ipaneli okanye imeko eyongezelelweyo.
xh.explanation: Ixesha, udidi lwesithuthi, umgama, ukubona okanye ezinye iimeko zinokutshintsha umyalezo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §4.4 — Combination signs (warning)

en.title: Combination warning signs
en.key_point: Interpret the warning sign together with its speed, distance, text or other supplementary message.
en.explanation: Combination warning signs add details such as recommended speed, distance to the hazard, length of the hazard or a text warning.

af.title: Gekombineerde waarskuwingstekens
af.key_point: Vertolk die waarskuwingsteken saam met die spoed-, afstand-, teks- of ander bykomende boodskap.
af.explanation: Die bykomende boodskap gee meer besonderhede oor die gevaar.

xh.title: Iimpawu zesilumkiso ezidityanisiweyo
xh.key_point: Tolika uphawu lwesilumkiso kunye nesantya, umgama, umbhalo okanye omnye umyalezo owongezelelweyo.
xh.explanation: Umyalezo owongezelelweyo unika iinkcukacha ezingakumbi ngengozi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §3.8 — De-restriction signs R600

en.title: De-restriction sign
en.key_point: The matching restriction ends from this point.
en.explanation: A de-restriction sign cancels the restriction shown by the similar symbol without the cancellation mark.

af.title: Opheffing van beperking
af.key_point: Die ooreenstemmende beperking eindig vanaf hierdie punt.
af.explanation: Die teken kanselleer die beperking wat deur die soortgelyke simbool aangedui is.

xh.title: Ukuphela komda
xh.key_point: Umda ohambelanayo uphela ukusukela kule ndawo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lurhoxisa umda oboniswe sisimboli esifanayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Count down signs IN3/IN2/IN1 and temporary variants

en.title: Exit countdown signs
en.key_point: These signs count down the remaining distance to an exit.
en.explanation: The manual uses a sequence at approximately 300 m, 200 m and 100 m before an exit so that you can prepare in time.

af.title: Afrit-afteltekens
af.key_point: Hierdie tekens tel die oorblywende afstand tot 'n afrit af.
af.explanation: Hulle help jou om betyds vir die afrit voor te berei.

xh.title: Iimpawu zokubala umgama wokuphuma
xh.key_point: Ezi mpawu zibonisa umgama oshiyekileyo ukuya kwindawo yokuphuma.
xh.explanation: Zikunceda ulungiselele ukuphuma kwangethuba.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Right-of-way IN7

en.title: Right-of-way information
en.key_point: You have right of way at the intersection ahead, but still make sure other road users yield.
en.explanation: Do not slow unnecessarily, but never assume that another road user will obey the sign.

af.title: Voorrang-inligting
af.key_point: Jy het voorrang by die kruising voor, maar maak steeds seker dat ander padgebruikers toegee.
af.explanation: Moenie aanvaar dat ander verkeer die teken sal gehoorsaam nie.

xh.title: Ulwazi lwelungelo lokudlula
xh.key_point: Unelungelo lokudlula kwindawo yokudibana ngaphambili, kodwa qinisekisa ukuba abanye abasebenzisi bendlela bayakunika indlela.
xh.explanation: Musa ukucinga ukuba ezinye izithuthi ziya kusoloko zithobela uphawu.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Park and ride IN9/IN10

en.title: Park and ride
en.key_point: This sign identifies parking connected to a bus or train service.
en.explanation: Use the parking area if you want to continue the journey by the public-transport service shown.

af.title: Parkeer en ry verder
af.key_point: Hierdie teken wys parkering wat met 'n bus- of treindiens verbind is.
af.explanation: Parkeer daar as jy jou reis met openbare vervoer wil voortsit.

xh.title: Paka uze uqhubeke ngezithuthi zikawonke-wonke
xh.key_point: Olu phawu lubonisa indawo yokupaka edityaniswe nenkonzo yebhasi okanye kaloliwe.
xh.explanation: Paka apho ukuba ufuna ukuqhubeka nohambo ngezithuthi zikawonke-wonke.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Supplementary plates IN11 series

en.title: Supplementary information plate
en.key_point: Read the supplementary plate together with the main sign.
en.explanation: It can explain the danger, a safe or recommended speed, how far away the condition is or how long it continues.

af.title: Aanvullende inligtingsplaat
af.key_point: Lees die aanvullende plaat saam met die hoofteken.
af.explanation: Dit kan die gevaar, aanbevole spoed, afstand of duur van die toestand verduidelik.

xh.title: Ipaneli yolwazi olongezelelweyo
xh.key_point: Funda ipaneli eyongezelelweyo kunye nophawu oluphambili.
xh.explanation: Inokuchaza ingozi, isantya esicetyiswayo, umgama okanye ixesha lemeko.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Information centre IN12

en.title: Information centre
en.key_point: An information office or notice board is available here.
en.explanation: You may obtain information about the local area at the place indicated.

af.title: Inligtingsentrum
af.key_point: 'n Inligtingskantoor of kennisgewingbord is hier beskikbaar.
af.explanation: Jy kan daar plaaslike inligting kry.

xh.title: Iziko lolwazi
xh.key_point: Kukho iofisi yolwazi okanye ibhodi yezaziso apha.
xh.explanation: Ungafumana ulwazi lwendawo apho.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Road experiment TIN13

en.title: Road experiment
en.key_point: Obey all other signs and watch carefully for people, vehicles and equipment involved in the temporary road experiment.
en.explanation: The sign warns that research or a temporary experiment is taking place on the road.

af.title: Padeksperiment
af.key_point: Gehoorsaam alle ander tekens en let versigtig op mense, voertuie en toerusting wat by die tydelike padeksperiment betrokke is.
af.explanation: Die teken waarsku dat navorsing of 'n tydelike eksperiment op die pad plaasvind.

xh.title: Uvavanyo lwendlela
xh.key_point: Thobela zonke ezinye iimpawu uze uqaphele abantu, izithuthi nezixhobo ezinxulumene novavanyo lwendlela lwethutyana.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lulumkisa ukuba kukho uphando okanye uvavanyo lwethutyana endleleni.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Co-ordinated traffic signals IN14

en.title: Co-ordinated traffic signals
en.key_point: The indicated speed is a recommendation intended to help you meet successive green signals, not a speed limit.
en.explanation: Even when following the recommended speed, enter every intersection only when it is safe.

af.title: Gekoördineerde verkeersligte
af.key_point: Die aangeduide spoed is 'n aanbeveling om opeenvolgende groen ligte te haal, nie 'n spoedgrens nie.
af.explanation: Betree elke kruising slegs wanneer dit veilig is.

xh.title: Iirobhothi ezilungelelanisiweyo
xh.key_point: Isantya esibonisiweyo sisicebiso sokukunceda ufike kwizibane eziluhlaza ezilandelelanayo, hayi umda wesantya.
xh.explanation: Ngena kwindawo nganye yokudibana kuphela xa kukhuselekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Multi-phase traffic signals IN15

en.title: Multi-phase traffic signals
en.key_point: Do not move just because traffic in another direction starts moving. Wait for your own green signal.
en.explanation: At a multi-phase intersection the normal sequence may differ, and your signal can remain red while other traffic receives green.

af.title: Meerfase-verkeersligte
af.key_point: Moenie beweeg net omdat verkeer in 'n ander rigting begin beweeg nie. Wag vir jou eie groen lig.
af.explanation: By 'n meerfase-kruising kan ander verkeersrigtings groen kry terwyl jou lig rooi bly.

xh.title: Iirobhothi zamacandelo amaninzi
xh.key_point: Musa ukuhamba nje kuba ezinye izithuthi kwenye indlela ziqalile ukuhamba. Linda isibane sakho esiluhlaza.
xh.explanation: Kwindawo yamacandelo amaninzi, ezinye izithuthi zinokufumana okuluhlaza ngelixa owakho umqondiso uselubomvu.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Bus stop ahead IN16

en.title: Bus stop ahead
en.key_point: Expect buses to slow or stop and watch for pedestrians nearby.
en.explanation: Take extra care when passing the bus-stop area.

af.title: Bushalte voor
af.key_point: Verwag dat busse stadiger ry of stop en let op voetgangers naby.
af.explanation: Wees ekstra versigtig wanneer jy die bushaltegebied verbysteek.

xh.title: Isikhululo sebhasi ngaphambili
xh.key_point: Lindela iibhasi ukuba zicothe okanye zime kwaye uqaphele abahambi ngeenyawo abakufutshane.
xh.explanation: Qaphela ngakumbi xa udlula kwindawo yesikhululo sebhasi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §6 — Modal transfer IN17/IN18/IN19

en.title: Modal transfer point
en.key_point: A place for passengers to change between forms of transport is nearby.
en.explanation: Slow or stop only when safe, and watch carefully for pedestrians who may cross the road.

af.title: Oorstappunt
af.key_point: 'n Plek waar passasiers tussen verskillende vervoervorme kan oorskakel, is naby.
af.explanation: Let op vir voetgangers wat na of van openbare vervoer beweeg.

xh.title: Indawo yokutshintsha indlela yothutho
xh.key_point: Kukho indawo ekufutshane apho abakhweli batshintsha phakathi kweendlela zothutho.
xh.explanation: Qaphela abahambi ngeenyawo abaya okanye abaphuma kwizithuthi zikawonke-wonke.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Left-edge RM4.1 and right-edge RM4.2

en.title: Road edge lines
en.key_point: Edge lines show the usable edge of the roadway and are not ordinary lane lines.
en.explanation: The left shoulder may be used only in limited circumstances described by the rules. A right-edge line on a one-way roadway or freeway should not be crossed.

af.title: Padkantlyne
af.key_point: Kantlyne wys die bruikbare rand van die rybaan en is nie gewone baanlyne nie.
af.explanation: Gebruik die padskouer net waar die reëls dit toelaat.

xh.title: Imigca esecaleni kwendlela
xh.key_point: Imigca esecaleni ibonisa umda osebenzayo wendlela kwaye ayizizo iilayini eziqhelekileyo.
xh.explanation: Sebenzisa igxalaba lendlela kuphela apho imithetho ivuma khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Parking bay RM6

en.title: Parking bay
en.key_point: Park completely inside the marked parking bay.
en.explanation: Do not leave any part of the vehicle outside the bay or over the sidewalk.

af.title: Parkeerplek
af.key_point: Parkeer heeltemal binne die gemerkte parkeerplek.
af.explanation: Moenie enige deel van die voertuig buite die gemerkte plek laat nie.

xh.title: Indawo yokupaka
xh.key_point: Paka ngokupheleleyo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokupaka ephawulweyo.
xh.explanation: Musa ukushiya naliphi na icandelo lesithuthi ngaphandle kwendawo ephawulweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Exclusive parking bay RM7

en.title: Exclusive parking bay
en.key_point: Only the road user or vehicle class identified by the marking may park there.
en.explanation: Examples include ambulance, bus, taxi, loading-zone and other specifically reserved bays.

af.title: Eksklusiewe parkeerplek
af.key_point: Net die padgebruiker of voertuigklas wat deur die merk aangedui word, mag daar parkeer.
af.explanation: Voorbeelde sluit busse, taxi's, ambulansvoertuie of laaisones in.

xh.title: Indawo yokupaka ekhethekileyo
xh.key_point: Kuphela ngumsebenzisi wendlela okanye udidi lwesithuthi oluboniswe luphawu olunokupaka apho.
xh.explanation: Imizekelo iquka iibhasi, iiteksi, ii-ambulensi okanye iindawo zokulayisha.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Bus lane marking RM9

en.title: Bus lane marking
en.key_point: If you are not driving a permitted bus, do not use the marked bus lane during the times shown.
en.explanation: The road marking identifies the reserved part of the carriageway.

af.title: Busbaanmerk
af.key_point: As jy nie 'n toegelate bus bestuur nie, moenie die gemerkte busbaan gebruik gedurende die tye wat aangedui word nie.
af.explanation: Die padmerk identifiseer die gereserveerde baan.

xh.title: Uphawu lwelayini yeebhasi
xh.key_point: Ukuba awuqhubi ibhasi evumelekileyo, musa ukusebenzisa ilayini yeebhasi ngamaxesha abonisiweyo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lwendlela lubonisa ilayini ebekelwe iibhasi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Pedestrian crossing ahead lines RM11

en.title: Pedestrian crossing ahead lines
en.key_point: Do not overtake in the marked approach area and be ready to stop for pedestrians.
en.explanation: The marking protects the approach to a pedestrian crossing.

af.title: Voetoorgang-voorlyne
af.key_point: Moenie in die gemerkte naderingsgebied verbysteek nie en wees gereed om vir voetgangers te stop.
af.explanation: Die merk beskerm die aanloop na 'n voetoorgang.

xh.title: Imigca yokulumkisa indawo yabahambi ngeenyawo
xh.key_point: Musa ukudlula kwindawo ephawulweyo yokusondela kwaye ulungele ukuma ngenxa yabahambi ngeenyawo.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lukhusela indawo esondela kwindawo yokuwela abahambi ngeenyawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Bicycle lane lines RM14

en.title: Bicycle lane lines
en.key_point: Do not drive in the area reserved for cyclists.
en.explanation: The marked lane shows the road space set aside for bicycle traffic.

af.title: Fietsbaanlyne
af.key_point: Moenie in die gebied bestuur wat vir fietsryers gereserveer is nie.
af.explanation: Die lyne wys die ruimte wat vir fietse bedoel is.

xh.title: Imigca yelayini yeebhayisekile
xh.key_point: Musa ukuqhuba kwindawo ebekelwe abakhweli beebhayisekile.
xh.explanation: Imigca ibonisa indawo ebekelwe iibhayisekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.1 — Traffic circle mandatory directional arrows RM15

en.title: Traffic-circle direction arrows
en.key_point: Drive around the circle only in the direction shown by the arrows.
en.explanation: The manual also reminds learners to yield according to the traffic-circle or mini-circle rules that apply.

af.title: Verkeersirkel-rigtingpyle
af.key_point: Ry net om die sirkel in die rigting wat deur die pyle aangedui word.
af.explanation: Volg ook die toepaslike toegee-reëls by die sirkel.

xh.title: Iintolo zesalathiso se-traffic circle
xh.key_point: Hamba ujikeleze kuphela kwicala eliboniswe ziintolo.
xh.explanation: Landela nemithetho yokunika indlela esebenzayo kwi-traffic circle.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Yield control ahead WM5

en.title: Yield control ahead marking
en.key_point: A yield control is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.
en.explanation: Watch for traffic approaching the intersection and give way when required.

af.title: Toeheebeheer voor-merk
af.key_point: 'n Toeheebeheer lê voor. Ry stadiger en wees gereed om te stop.
af.explanation: Let op verkeer by die kruising en gee pad wanneer dit nodig is.

xh.title: Uphawu lokunika indlela ngaphambili
xh.key_point: Kukho indawo yokunika indlela ngaphambili. Cotha uze ulungele ukuma.
xh.explanation: Qaphela izithuthi kwindawo yokudibana kwaye unike indlela xa kufuneka.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Lane reduction arrows WM6.1/WM6.2/WM6.3

en.title: Lane reduction arrows
en.key_point: One or more lanes end ahead. Change lanes early and safely.
en.explanation: Check blind spots carefully, especially where lanes reduce from both sides.

af.title: Baanverminderingspyle
af.key_point: Een of meer bane eindig voor. Verander vroeg en veilig van baan.
af.explanation: Kontroleer blindekolle voordat jy invoeg.

xh.title: Iintolo zokuncipha kweelayini
xh.key_point: Enye okanye ezinye iilayini ziphela ngaphambili. Tshintsha ilayini kwangethuba nangokukhuselekileyo.
xh.explanation: Jonga iindawo ezingabonakaliyo ngaphambi kokudibana nenye ilayini.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Mandatory direction arrow ahead WM7

en.title: Mandatory direction ahead marking
en.key_point: You will soon have to follow the direction shown, so choose the correct lane in time.
en.explanation: The marking warns you before the mandatory direction applies at the next intersection.

af.title: Verpligte rigting voor-merk
af.key_point: Jy sal binnekort die rigting moet volg wat aangedui word; kies dus betyds die korrekte baan.
af.explanation: Die merk waarsku jou voordat die verpligte rigting begin.

xh.title: Uphawu lwendlela yesalathiso esinyanzelekileyo ngaphambili
xh.key_point: Kungekudala kuya kufuneka ulandele icala elibonisiweyo, ngoko khetha ilayini echanekileyo kwangethuba.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lukulumkisa ngaphambi kokuba isalathiso esinyanzelekileyo siqale.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — No overtaking/no crossing line ahead WM8

en.title: No-overtaking or no-crossing line ahead
en.key_point: Return to the correct side of the road before the prohibition line begins.
en.explanation: The marking warns that a no-overtaking or no-crossing line is ahead.

af.title: Geen-verbysteek- of geen-kruislyn voor
af.key_point: Keer terug na die korrekte kant van die pad voordat die verbodslyn begin.
af.explanation: Die merk waarsku dat 'n verbodslyn voorlê.

xh.title: Umgca wokungadluli okanye wokungaweli ngaphambili
xh.key_point: Buyela kwicala elichanekileyo lendlela ngaphambi kokuba umgca wothintelo uqale.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lulumkisa ukuba kukho umgca wothintelo ngaphambili.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Arrestor bed ahead WM9

en.title: Arrestor bed ahead
en.key_point: An emergency arrestor bed is ahead for a vehicle whose brakes have failed.
en.explanation: Do not enter an arrestor bed in normal driving.

af.title: Noodrembed voor
af.key_point: 'n Noodrembed lê voor vir 'n voertuig waarvan die remme gefaal het.
af.explanation: Moenie dit tydens gewone bestuur gebruik nie.

xh.title: Indawo yokumisa isithuthi esingasakwazi kuqhobosha ngaphambili
xh.key_point: Kukho indawo yokumisa engxamisekileyo ngaphambili yesithuthi esiphulukene neziqhoboshi.
xh.explanation: Musa ukuyisebenzisa ekuqhubeni okuqhelekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.2 — Speed hump WM10

en.title: Speed-hump road marking
en.key_point: Slow down before the speed hump.
en.explanation: The marking warns that a raised speed-control feature is immediately ahead.

af.title: Spoedhobbel-padmerk
af.key_point: Ry stadiger voordat jy die spoedhobbel bereik.
af.explanation: Die merk waarsku dat 'n verhoogde spoedbeheerfunksie onmiddellik voorlê.

xh.title: Uphawu lwendlela lwe-speed hump
xh.key_point: Cotha ngaphambi kokufika kwi-speed hump.
xh.explanation: Uphawu lulumkisa ukuba kukho indawo ephakanyisiweyo yokunciphisa isantya ngaphambili.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.3 — Guide lines GM2

en.title: Guide lines
en.key_point: Follow the guide lines through the intersection.
en.explanation: They show the correct path for turning or passing through a complex intersection.

af.title: Gidslyne
af.key_point: Volg die gidslyne deur die kruising.
af.explanation: Hulle wys die korrekte pad deur 'n ingewikkelde aansluiting.

xh.title: Imigca yesikhokelo
xh.key_point: Landela imigca yesikhokelo kwindawo yokudibana.
xh.explanation: Ibonisa indlela echanekileyo yokuhamba kwindawo enzima yokudibana.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.3 — Bifurcation arrows GM3

en.title: Bifurcation arrows
en.key_point: The number of lanes increases ahead. Stay within the lane markings.
en.explanation: Do not straddle lane lines as the roadway divides into additional lanes.

af.title: Vertakkingspyle
af.key_point: Die aantal bane neem voor toe. Bly binne die baanmerke.
af.explanation: Moenie baanlyne oorskry of oor twee bane ry soos die pad vertak nie.

xh.title: Iintolo zokwahluka kweendlela
xh.key_point: Inani leelayini liyanda ngaphambili. Hlala ngaphakathi kwemigca yelayini.
xh.explanation: Musa ukuhamba phezu kwemigca njengoko indlela yahluleka ibe ziilayini ezininzi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.3 — Information arrows GM4.1/GM4.2

en.title: Information arrows
en.key_point: Follow the direction shown for your lane or roadway.
en.explanation: Do not drive contrary to the arrow unless a traffic officer directs you otherwise.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.3 — Bicycle crossing lines GM5

en.title: Bicycle crossing lines
en.key_point: Watch for cyclists crossing or waiting to cross.
en.explanation: The lines identify the part of the road intended for cyclists to cross.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.3 — Road marking symbols GM6.1/GM6.2/GM6.3

en.title: Road-marking symbols
en.key_point: A painted symbol can identify a reserved user group or a destination.
en.explanation: Do not use a marked reserved area if you are not part of the group identified by the symbol.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §7.3 — Word markings GM7

en.title: Word markings
en.key_point: Read the road message and respond to the condition or danger it identifies.
en.explanation: Word markings provide extra information directly on the roadway.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §8 — Flashing red arrow to the left

en.title: Flashing red arrow left
en.key_point: Stop first. You may turn left only when it is safe and after yielding to pedestrians and conflicting traffic.
en.explanation: Treat the signal as a stop before making the permitted left turn.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §8 — Constant amber arrow

en.title: Constant amber arrow
en.key_point: Stop and wait for the signal that permits movement in the arrow direction.
en.explanation: Do not proceed simply because the arrow is illuminated amber.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §8 — Flashing green arrows

en.title: Flashing green arrow
en.key_point: You have right of way in the direction shown by the flashing green arrow.
en.explanation: Proceed in the indicated direction while remaining alert to road users who may disobey their controls.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §8 — Constant green arrow

en.title: Constant green arrow
en.key_point: Traffic must proceed in the direction shown by the green arrow.
en.explanation: The arrow can be used to control the permitted direction of travel.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs §8 — Flashing amber disc

en.title: Flashing amber signal
en.key_point: Proceed carefully and yield to pedestrians.
en.explanation: A flashing amber disc requires caution rather than an automatic stop.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Guidance: location signs GLS/GL families

en.title: Location signs
en.key_point: Location signs identify places such as streets, suburbs, towns, borders, passes, interchanges and named routes.
en.explanation: The wording on these signs varies by place, so the learner must understand their purpose rather than memorise a fixed destination name.

source.locator: NaTIS/SADC guidance signs — national route marker family

en.title: National route marker
en.key_point: A national route marker identifies a numbered national route.
en.explanation: The route number changes by location; learn the route-marker shape and function rather than one specific route number.

source.locator: NaTIS/SADC guidance signs — provincial route marker family

en.title: Provincial route marker
en.key_point: A provincial route marker identifies a numbered provincial route.
en.explanation: The route number varies by location. The important knowledge is recognising the marker type and following the route number shown.

source.locator: NaTIS/SADC guidance signs — regional route marker family

en.title: Regional route marker
en.key_point: A regional route marker identifies a numbered regional route.
en.explanation: Use the displayed route number to follow the correct regional road.

source.locator: NaTIS/SADC guidance signs — metropolitan route marker family

en.title: Metropolitan route marker
en.key_point: A metropolitan route marker identifies a numbered route within a metropolitan road network.
en.explanation: The letter and number shown vary by city and route.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Guidance direction signs: ground-mounted / overhead / map- and stack-type

en.title: Direction signs
en.key_point: Direction signs show destinations, route numbers, lane choices and the direction to follow.
en.explanation: Read destination text, arrows, route markers and lane information together before changing position.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Freeway direction signs

en.title: Freeway direction signs
en.key_point: Freeway guidance signs provide advance, lane and exit information so that drivers can choose the correct lane in good time.
en.explanation: The app separately teaches the GA1–GA6 core exit sequence. Other freeway signs use the same principle: read route, destination, lane and arrow information together.

source.locator: NaTIS/SADC Road Traffic Signs — tourism and service guidance symbols

en.title: Tourism and service guidance
en.key_point: Tourism and service signs guide road users to attractions, emergency services, fuel, food, accommodation, parking and other facilities.
en.explanation: The exact pictogram varies with the facility. Treat the pictogram and any accompanying text as guidance, not as a regulatory instruction.

source.locator: NaTIS/SADC Road Traffic Signs — diagrammatic signs: lane changes, merges, obstructions and lane-use layouts

en.title: Diagrammatic guidance signs
en.key_point: Diagrammatic signs show the road layout ahead, including merging, diverging, obstructions and lane-use changes.
en.explanation: Use the diagram to choose the correct lane early and safely.

source.locator: SADC Road Traffic Signs Manual — local direction, pedestrian direction and toll direction sign families

en.title: Local, pedestrian and toll guidance
en.key_point: Special guidance signs may direct local traffic, pedestrians or vehicles approaching toll facilities.
en.explanation: Follow the destination, lane and directional information shown. These are variable-content guidance signs rather than fixed regulatory symbols.

source.locator: SADC Road Traffic Signs Manual — Variable Message Signs

en.title: Variable message signs
en.key_point: Read and obey the current message displayed on an electronic or variable sign.
en.explanation: The message can change to warn about incidents, lane closures, congestion or another temporary condition.
